2608.30929.title: Annotated Surrogate Retrieval for Polish Statutory Law
2608.30929.paper_summary: We present a family of retrieval methods for Polish statutory law built on document surrogates: language-model annotations attached to statutory articles at index time. Three designs occupy different points on the cost-quality frontier. ASCR is a surrogate cascade with reranking; ASCR-H fuses a dense list into that cascade; and DTF replaces both language-model stages with three lexical and dense retrievers, weighted reciprocal rank fusion, and a deterministic re-scoring prior, using no model call before generation. We evaluate all three against fourteen lexical, dense, fused and ablated baselines plus four controls, on 300 questions from the 2024 and 2025 Polish bar and legal counsel entrance examinations (264 with their reference article in the corpus), over 82,508 articles from 1,133 acts. On paired McNemar tests, ASCR-H places the reference provision at rank one significantly more often than every other non-oracle configuration except one of its own ablations (eighteen of twenty comparisons significant in its favour at p < 0.005), reaching 72.3% against 61.7% for BM25 and 52.3% for dense retrieval. The advantage is concentrated at the head and does not survive depth: it is significant at cutoffs of one and five, disappears by ten, and by twenty DTF leads on point estimate (86.0% versus 84.5%) at one ninth the latency and less than half the cost. Ablation attributes 27.6 points of rank-one accuracy to the reranking stage alone. We further report that the ranking advantage does not extend to citation accuracy, where DTF matches the oracle ceiling, and three negative results on lemmatisation, pseudo-relevance feedback and query rewriting. Surrogate annotation covers 27.0% of the corpus but every reference provision in the benchmark, an asymmetry we disclose and discuss. Benchmark, per-question outputs and paired significance tests are publicly available.
2608.30929.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一系列基於文件代理的波蘭法定法律檢索方法：在索引時附加於法條的語言模型註釋。三種設計在成本-品質邊界上佔據不同的位置。ASCR 是一個帶有重新排序的代理級聯；ASCR-H 將一個密集列表融合進該級聯；而 DTF 則用三個詞彙和密集檢索器、加權的倒數排名融合以及一個確定性的重新評分先驗替代了兩個語言模型階段，在生成之前不進行任何模型調用。我們對這三種方法進行評估，對比十四個詞彙、密集、融合和消融的基準，加上四個對照組，基於來自2024年和2025年波蘭律師及法律顧問入學考試的300個問題（其中264個有其參考文章在語料庫中），涵蓋1,133部法案中的82,508篇文章。在配對的McNemar測試中，ASCR-H顯著更頻繁地將參考條款置於第一名，超過了所有其他非預言配置，只有其一個消融例外（在二十次比較中有十八次顯著支持其優勢，p < 0.005），達到72.3%，相比之下BM25為61.7%，密集檢索為52.3%。這一優勢集中在前幾名，並未持續到更深的層次：在一和五的截止點上顯著，但在十的時候消失，到了二十時DTF在點估計上領先（86.0%對84.5%），延遲為其九分之一且成本不到一半。消融分析將27.6個百分點的第一名準確率歸因於重新排序階段。我們進一步報告，排名優勢並未延伸至引用準確率，DTF達到了預言的上限，並在詞形還原、偽相關反饋和查詢重寫上有三個負面結果。代理註釋覆蓋了27.0%的語料庫，但在基準中每個參考條款都有，這是一個我們揭示並討論的不對稱性。基準、每題輸出和配對顯著性測試均可公開獲得。
